dendro.frameOrder: Core.Tick: Combat.Tick (including gadget tick) before Player.Tick before Tasks.Run; spawn at frame 54 happens after that frame combat tick, first decrement at 55; first attack at 91 then ThinkInterval=90 produces 181 etc.
dendro.condition: C0, fresh lamp surviving to natural removal, no elemental transformation or replacement; actual eligible target/selected-target contact recorded independently.

passiveEvidence.anemo: A1 belongs to last normal attack; A4 to skill kills and healing. Neither adds C0 Q damage. No C6 shred at C0.

dendro.a1: After spawn, ascension>=1 schedules stack tasks at 54+60n (max10) and buff refreshes every18 frames while burst status Duration>0. Buff applies only to active character within lamp radius; previous character loses it on swap. Last possible no-transformation refresh is756, stat modifier expires816.
dendro.a4: Ascension>=4 reads actual current EM at damage application via AttackMod and adds EM*0.001 burst damage bonus. This is distinct from the offensive snapshot at54. Input bonus must declare the same A4 share already included.
dendro.a1ReactionMastery: A1 grows after lamp offensive snapshot; do not retroactively add current A1 EM to54f reaction snapshot. A4 uses impact-time EM including actually active A1 or other buffs.

scope.numericalPolicy: Canonical catalog and actual gender optimizer vector agree exactly. Source compatibility is a cross-source conditioned reconstruction, not a claim that the old gcsim numeric discrepancy disappeared.
